roadmap.title: Finish the original achievements
roadmap.description: Play ordinary matches on the maps that hold the pickups, targets and windows, and set up the single-kill and counter goals.

roadmap.title: Set up games with a friend
roadmap.description: Use a partner and a party to arrange the grenade, hat, draw, party, score and win-streak achievements.

roadmap.title: Finish the long grinds
roadmap.description: Reach 300 leaderboard points and get a kill with every weapon.

achievements.description: Perform a rocket jump
achievements.summary: Perform a rocket jump.

steps.text: Play @loc{Arena_04}, which has rocket launchers.
Pick up a @item{Rocket Launcher}, then jump and fire a rocket into the ground below you.

achievements.description: Break 20 windows
achievements.summary: Break 20 windows.

guide.context: Broken windows come back only when the round changes.

steps.text: Play @loc{HK_02}, which has windows.
Break windows until you reach 20.

achievements.description: Kill your opponent with a headshot
achievements.summary: Kill an opponent with a headshot.

steps.text: Shoot an opponent in the head until they die.

achievements.description: Throw a ragdoll into the void
achievements.summary: Throw a ragdoll into the void.

guide.context: Patch 1.4.9 (16 Sep 2026) fixed this achievement being given by mistake. The shooting method comes from a guide updated one day before that patch, so it is not confirmed after the fix.

steps.text: Kill an opponent so that a body is left on the map.
Shoot the corpse until it falls into the void.

achievements.description: Kill your enemy with a sniper noscope
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a sniper rifle without aiming down the sights.

steps.text: Play @loc{Neo_Arena_00} or @loc{Neo_Arena_06}, which have sniper rifles.
Pick up a sniper rifle and kill an enemy without holding right click to aim.

achievements.description: Kill your opponent with a prop
achievements.summary: Kill an opponent with a prop.

guide.context: You can also do this on the Training Ground, which helps if you have no partner.

steps.text: Play @loc{Prison_00}, which has barrels.
Grab a @item{barrel} using F and hurl it at an enemy. Repeat until an enemy dies from it.

achievements.description: Taser your enemy
achievements.summary: Shoot an enemy with a taser.

steps.text: Play @loc{Neo_Arena_04_0}, which has tasers.
Pick up a @item{Taser} and fire it at an enemy.

achievements.description: Break 50 pots
achievements.summary: Break 50 pots.

guide.context: You can also do this on the Training Ground, which helps if you have no partner.

steps.text: Play @loc{WestVillage_04}, which has pots.
Break 50 pots.

achievements.description: Play 5 games
achievements.summary: Finish 5 games.

steps.text: Play 5 games to the end.

achievements.description: Get 43 kills
achievements.summary: Get 43 kills.

steps.text: Kill opponents until you reach 43 kills in total.

achievements.description: Blow up yourself and an enemy with any grenade
achievements.summary: Die together with an enemy from a grenade explosion.

steps.text: Play @loc{Adorbe_01} with a friend. The map has grenades.
Pick up a @item{grenade}, get your friend close to you, and throw it at your own feet so that both of you die.

achievements.description: Kill an opponent in 5 seconds when a take starts
achievements.summary: Kill an opponent within 5 seconds of a take starting.

steps.text: Play @loc{valhalla_05}.
As soon as a take starts, kill your opponent within 5 seconds.

achievements.description: Win a game where an opponent has zero score
achievements.summary: Win a game in which an opponent finishes with zero score.

guide.context: The same game also unlocks Blowout.

steps.text: Host a game with a friend and set it to 2 rounds.
Win both rounds so your friend scores nothing.

achievements.description: Win a game where you won every round
achievements.summary: Win a game after winning every round in it.

guide.context: The same game also unlocks Unfair.

steps.text: Host a game with a friend and set it to 2 rounds.
Win both rounds.

achievements.description: Play in a match with a steam friend
achievements.summary: Play a match with a Steam friend.

guide.context: This also unlocks while you work toward Friendslop.

steps.text: Start a game with a Steam friend in your party.

achievements.description: Play in a match with 3 steam friends
achievements.summary: Play a match with 3 Steam friends.

steps.text: Add 3 players as Steam friends.
Have all 3 join your party.
Start a game with all 3 in it.

achievements.description: Get a kill with every weapon at least once
achievements.summary: Kill an opponent at least once with each weapon in the game.

guide.context: Steam does not say which weapons count, and this list comes from one community guide whose author was unsure. The community wiki also names weapons such as Claymore, Proximity Mine, AP Mine and Stun Grenade; try them if the achievement does not unlock. The paid Maps, Weapons and Hats DLC adds exclusive guns, and no source says whether they count.

achievements.description: Win 3 games in a row
achievements.summary: Win 3 games in a row.

steps.text: Set the game to the lowest round count.
Win 3 full games one after another.

achievements.description: Get 10 headshots
achievements.summary: Get 10 headshots.

steps.text: Play @loc{valhalla_05} and aim for the head until you have 10 headshots.

achievements.description: Get 10 melee weapon kills
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills with melee weapons.

steps.text: Play @loc{hk_04} and kill opponents with melee weapons until you have 10 kills.

achievements.description: Knock off a players hat
achievements.summary: Knock a hat off another player's head.

guide.context: Only one guide covers this, and its author was not sure of the method.

steps.text: Ask your friend to put on a hat in the cosmetics menu.
Start a game together and shoot the hat off their head.

achievements.description: Have a draw
achievements.summary: Have a draw with another player.

steps.text: Kill the other player at the same moment they kill you.

achievements.description: Have 300 or more leaderboard points
achievements.summary: Reach 300 leaderboard points.

steps.text: Host games on @loc{TheSamePlace_08} set to 2 rounds.
Win both rounds of every game. A round win gives 1 point and a full game win gives 4, so each game gives 6.
Keep playing until you reach 300 points, about 50 won games.

achievements.description: Finish exactly 1 point ahead of the runner-up
achievements.summary: Win a game by exactly 1 point over the second-place player.

guide.context: Only one guide covers this, and its round counts are unclear: a 2-round game could end level. Check that the final score leaves you exactly 1 point ahead.

steps.text: Host a game with a friend and set it to 2 rounds.
Let your friend win the first round.
Then win 2 rounds yourself.

achievements.description: Finish exactly 1 point behind the winner
achievements.summary: Finish a game exactly 1 point behind the winner.

guide.context: Only one guide covers this, and its round counts are unclear: a 2-round game could end level. Check that the final score leaves you exactly 1 point behind.

steps.text: Host a game with a friend and set it to 2 rounds.
Win the first round.
Then let your friend win the second round.
